_comment: Which systemd units the dashboard counts requests from (journal-based req/sec/min/hour/day). Edit the 'units' lists to add/remove instances - no code change needed. 'request_pattern' is the journalctl --grep regex that matches exactly ONE log line per served request. Env vars VLLM_UNITS / OLLAMA_UNITS / VLLM_REQUEST_PATTERN / OLLAMA_REQUEST_PATTERN still override this file if set.
